scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 7 good with notable issues; 10 exceptional within observed scope. Subjective holistic scores, not outcome-derived certification or average of categories.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent and playable observed mobile slice with effective planning and assistance, but repeated blocked routes and difficulty responding to offscreen threats materially disrupted play. Both losses inform observed friction rather than automatically lowering the grade.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement/fire worked; tap aim killed guard and disabled coil, approach reduced precision demands. Turning, target selection and moving around cover were difficult through this interface; fine FIRE drag and AIM mode were not systematically assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, shield regeneration, distinct enemy pressure and coil exposure cycles created observable tactical choices. Rear pressure while navigating and stationary holds was punishing. Upload and victory content unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber visual hierarchy, atmospheric rain, coherent title/results and readable rifle/HUD. Dark architecture and close cover frequently filled the narrow scene; audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Map pauses and remains open, route lines and reach distance help, visible fresh-start option worked. Translating overhead paths into unobstructed first-person movement remained hard. No settings changes.
reasons.readability: Handbook, large controls, recovery prompts and end stats legible at 390x844. Small compressed threat/status lines and dense HUD competed for attention; environmental signs sometimes partly occluded.
